findings.label: Reused banner permission
findings.detail: Admin team routes guard with auth.PermBannerManage rather than a dedicated team.manage permission. Deliberate per the plan's product decision (team is treated as the same content/merchandising capability as banners). If team management should later be an isolated capability, that is a follow-up RBAC change.

findings.label: Caveats not exercised at build time
findings.detail: The migration was not applied against a live Postgres and the photo upload round-trip was not exercised end to end (no DB in the sandbox). Both reuse existing unchanged infrastructure. Run migrate up and verify a photo upload in a DB-backed environment before release.
